collection.title: VW Tiguan/Tiguan Allspace 2016 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The VW Tiguan 2016 - 2020 model requires a 26" wiper blade on both drivers side and a 21" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Tiguan, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
